title: Valid Permutations for DI Sequence
description: Count the number of permutations of {0, 1, ..., n} that satisfy the given DI (decreasing-increasing) pattern.

steps.note: Initialize DP array for DI string 'ID' (n=2). Base case: all permutations of length 1 are valid.
Processing 'I': compute prefix sums to count increasing sequences.
Update DP for 'I'. Current valid sequences for 'ID' after 'I'.
Processing 'D': compute suffix sums for decreasing sequences.
Final update for 'D'. Total valid permutations: 1.
